questions.stem: Which of the following is a cause of kidney failure?

options.text: Eating too much protein in a single meal
Producing too much ADH from the pituitary gland
Long-term high blood pressure damaging the glomeruli
Drinking too much water over several days

questions.explanation: Long-term high blood pressure is a major cause of kidney failure because it damages the delicate blood vessels in the glomeruli. Other causes include diabetes, infections, and inherited conditions like polycystic kidney disease.
